article_summaries.title: Summer Camp All Summer Long
article_summaries.summary: A Free Realms news post announcing the summer Community Team event season: Chatty's summer camp in Greenwood Forest (reached by a newly activated Warpstone) and Robbie the Robgoblin's rival camp across the lake, with weekly themed events through Labor Day. It gives the expected in-game event schedule and how to join events via the Game Guide calendar.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New? (Campamento de Verano – Semana Deportiva)
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language official news post for the Free Realms Summer Camp event, covering its Sports Week theme. It gives the scheduled times for in-game community events and explains how to reach them via the Game Guide calendar. The exact post date is not shown (only 'Posted 10 months, 4 weeks ago' relative to capture), so it is undated.

article_summaries.title: Segundo Año de Super Spooktacular (Free Realms - What is New?)
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language Free Realms news post announcing the second year of the Super Spooktacular Halloween event. It covers costumes, Pixiewood decorations, the /scare trick-or-treat mechanic, daily quests, world events, the Bone Marsh battle instance, and a Trading Card Game (JCC) Halloween pack offer. The post's date is not shown; it is only given as 'posted 7 months, 2 weeks ago' at the 2011-06-04 capture, so it is roughly late 2010.

article_summaries.title: Segundo Año de Super Spooktacular (Free Realms - What is New?)
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language official news post announcing the second year of the Super Spooktacular Halloween event. It describes costumes, decorations, a /scare trick-or-treat system, daily quests, world and community events, the Bone Bog Cemetery battle instance, and a Trading Card Game (JCC) Halloween pack. The post gives no exact date; it was captured in June 2011 and says it was posted about 7 months and 2 weeks earlier.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A freerealms.com community news post announcing the '2011 Kick Off Party' Community Event, held at the stage in Snowhill on Server 1 in two sessions for different regions. It describes the Community Team's weekly Thursday meetups in different in-game places. The post's exact date is not shown; it is listed as posted 4 days and 1 hour before the January 10, 2011 capture.

article_summaries.title: Evento Comunitario: Fiesta de Inicio al 2011
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language official freerealms.com community event notice announcing the first community party of 2011, held on a stage in Snowy Hill on Server 1. The Community Team said it gathers at a different location each Thursday, and players were asked to bring favorite outfits and boomboxes. Event times are given per region in Pacific Time.
